تشتعلون (form VIII)
# تَشْتَعِلُونَ (taštaʕilūna) /taʃ.ta.ʕi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# تُشْتَعَلُونَ (tuštaʕalūna) /tuʃ.ta.ʕa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
